portal_description:
The resource-agents-sap-hana-scaleout packages provide an SAP HANA scale-out resource agent interface with Pacemaker that allows SAP HANA scale-out instances to be managed in a cluster environment.

* SAPHanaController: Integrating systemd based SAP Start-Up Framework for HA solutions for SAP HANA Scale-Out. (BZ#2043016)
